decisions.reason: Automatic product-type assignment within TikTok does not change what products must be recorded in the tracking spreadsheet.
The source decision is explicitly limited to TikTok and does not change Shopify publication behavior.
TikTok's automatic assignment of product type does not change CJ product selection, import, or accepted selection signals.
Daily social-media content scheduling and publishing is unrelated to TikTok Shop product-type assignment.
The content-bank deliverable is unaffected by automatic product-type assignment in TikTok Shop.
The Pinterest Task 2 deliverable is unrelated to TikTok Shop product listing metadata.
